stage_definitions.parsed_entries: Rows extracted from RSS/Atom/RDF (Google or direct publisher); count may include repeated titles
stage_definitions.date_passed: Publication time within rolling 24h + 20 min future tolerance, with valid HTTPS URL and title
stage_definitions.geography_matched: Passed existing conservative geography matchers and disambiguation safeguards before deduplication
stage_definitions.deduplication_survived: Mapped rows retained after canonical URL and same-location near-title deduplication; attribution goes to the first retained feed
stage_definitions.globe_articles: Retained records included among at most 20 articles serialized per location/category globe signal

notes: Source feed region is discovery metadata, NOT event location evidence.
Feed ordering affects attribution of identical articles across multiple feeds; this audit shows retained-row contribution, not exclusive publisher value.
Date-pass counts exclude malformed title or URL; see invalid_article.
No inferred locations have been added or remapped.
